name: Union membership and representation by state (BLS Union Members), 2024 and 2025
description: Employed wage and salary workers, union members and workers represented by unions (members plus workers covered by a union contract) in every state, DC and the nation, from the Bureau of Labor Statistics' annual Union Members release (Current Population Survey): numbers in thousands as BLS prints them, each as a percent of employed workers, for the latest year and the year before, with the change in the members' percent. The 2025 annual figures average the 11 months BLS published (January to September, November and December).
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Union membership and representation by state (BLS Union Members), 2024 and 2025 (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23845987
keywords: workers represented by unions by state

distribution.name: union-membership.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: union-membership.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: union-membership
recordSet.description: The records of Union membership and representation by state (BLS Union Members), 2024 and 2025, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code (50 states and DC), or US

field.name: level
field.description: us or state

field.name: stateName
field.description: State name (United States on the national record)

field.name: year
field.description: The latest year in the BLS release

field.name: status
field.description: P: the BLS figure as printed

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Percent of employed wage and salary workers who are union members (the same as members_pct)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: employed_k
field.description: Employed wage and salary workers, thousands (sole or principal job; self-employed excluded)

field.name: members_k
field.description: Members of a labor union or an employee association similar to a union, thousands

field.name: members_pct
field.description: members_k as a percent of employed_k (BLS)

field.name: represented_k
field.description: Union members plus workers with no union affiliation whose jobs are covered by a union or employee association contract, thousands

field.name: represented_pct
field.description: represented_k as a percent of employed_k (BLS)

field.name: previousYear
field.description: The year before (the second year of the release)

field.name: employed_k_prev
field.description: employed_k in previousYear

field.name: members_k_prev
field.description: members_k in previousYear

field.name: members_pct_prev
field.description: members_pct in previousYear

field.name: represented_k_prev
field.description: represented_k in previousYear

field.name: represented_pct_prev
field.description: represented_pct in previousYear

field.name: change_members_pct_pts
field.description: members_pct minus members_pct_prev, percentage points

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
